Solution B is correct.

Solution B counts all 5-member subcommittees and subtracts the single-party ones: C(14,5) = 2002, and 2002 − C(8,5) − C(6,5) = 2002 − 56 − 6 = 1940.

Solution A omits the case of 4 Republicans and 2... more precisely 4 Republicans and 1 Democrat, which gives C(8,4)·C(6,1) = 70·6 = 420 ways. Adding this to A's total gives 1520 + 420 = 1940, which matches B.

WINNER: B
